what_this_does_not_say: It does not say the bank entry is dead on its own base class (that is the separate q3-4b row, failed(removal) at the pinned config). It says the premise of §6 — a base-fitted axis transfers to a fine-tune of that base — is false on this, the top-downloaded Q4_K_M fine-tune.
It does not claim the merged model refuses more; it delivers less. Refusal-shaped wording fell, refusal-shaped answers rose.
It does not grade retention by agent read; the 241 rows are deterministic math/code scorers with `passed` per row.
